answer.summary: A controlled, peer-reviewed experiment from 2022 to 2024 is required to evaluate agent memory retention or state evolution under token constraints with measurable, baseline-reported metrics.
answer.content: The search must identify a single peer-reviewed paper that details a controlled experiment involving agent memory with explicit token budgeting, observable memory state changes, and quantitative baseline comparisons to validate performance under shared, bounded conditions. No implementation or system design is permitted in this phase.
